strings.en: 1. Destroy all foes, rescue Excellen.
1. Ra Cailum or Alteisen Riese destroyed. 2. Win conditions unmet.
This is...!? ...Captain, are you sure this is the place?
Nobody's here...?
No, this is definitely it...
Kyosuke?
Kyosuke... She's here?
...Probably.
That's all well and good, but what now? We gonna search for her?
The Einst have appeared out of nowhere before. We can't relax, but...
What'll we do? We can't dawdle forever.
...Excellen.
Ah, Kyosuke!
Kyosuke Nanbu... Alteisen Riese, launching!
He just went out on his own... Captain Bright?
Is he... sensing something? Like a Newtype?
I don't think that's it... It's something else...
...I don't get it.
We're going out too.
We have to look around anyway, right?
True...
Excellen! You're nearby, aren't you!? Come out...!
Captain Bright! Something's coming this way!
Hm!?
That's...!
The ID code, no doubt about it... The Weissritter...!? Open a channel!
Sorry to keep you waiting! Excellen Browning, now returning~!
Big Sis Excellen!?
Geez, making us worry! What're you doing out here!
Stuff happened, lots of stuff.
Grown-up reasons... you know? Right, Kyosuke?
Same as ever, it seems.
...I hate to doubt her, but her machine may have been rigged.
Captain, I'm not sure we should let the Weissritter land right away...
Geez, Brother! She finally came back, and you're being so cold!
Better safe than sorry. What if her machine's rigged with explosives?
Either way... I'm glad for you, Kyosuke.
Huh? No permission to land? Some kind of argument?
Kyosuke, say something too...
You... aren't Excellen.
What!?
...H-Hey now, isn't that joke a bit harsh?
She may act like that normally... but at a time like this,
she wouldn't be cracking jokes.
And... something about you is different. That much... is certain.
C'mon, she's always like that. And "something's different"...
...Kyosuke!?
Geez... it's been so long... d-don't... s-say... th-things... like...
...Tch.
The sHip's hatch... is sealeD... You caNNot sortie... EarthLings...!
What did you say!?
What, just like that!? Is the hatch really... Captain!?
What...!? A powerful magnetic field is gripping the Ra Cailum...!
She's still under the enemy's control!?
Or maybe she isn't that woman at all!? Like the Death Army...
...No, King of Hearts... She's the real thing...!
Kyosuke... how can you be so sure?
...I'm certain...
This is no time to argue! What do we do!
If the hatch won't open, we can't even sortie!
Then... the only one who can fight is...
Besides the Ra Cailum... the only one out there... is his Alteisen.
Captain, you can't mean...!?
You're not gonna tell Kyosuke to shoot down Excellen... are you?
...Hmm.
Ngh... The Einst's lackeys!
...What do I... What should I do...!
Kyosuke! We'll find some way to get ourselves out there!
Until then... hold out!
Roger. ...She's the one who rigged the Ra Cailum.
...Then... if I shoot her down...!
No!
No... Absolutely not! We can save her! We can definitely save her!
Don't do something you'll regret, Kyosuke!
Princess...
...Understood. Sorry, Princess.
Find a way to remove this magnetic field, whatever it takes!
All pilots, stand by on deck!
...Here I come, Excellen...!
Ugh... uuh... aaaah...!
Did he do it...!?
Excellen!
...Ugh... uuh...
Your... role... is over...
Role...? What do you mean, role!?
(This is... coming from the Weissritter's... that red orb...!)
...Understood... understood... under...stood.
I don't know what you wanted to learn... but why only Excellen!
You could've taken me too!
...You are... incomplete... Therefore... unnecessary...
(Incomplete...? Compared to what...!?)
Ah... ngh...
The Weissritter!? Excellen! Hey!
Something's... leaving...!?
Yeah, that nasty feeling... it's fading!
Excellen...! Wake up! Excellen!
...My purpose is to oversee... all who... disturb the land of beginnings...
(What!? What is she talking about!?)
The hatch!?
Still no good! Oh, what should we do...!
Nanbu! Hold out a little longer!
...Ngh... Excellen...!
Kyo...su...
Th-This feeling...
Nooo, this enemy...
What... a nasty sensation...
What the heck is this... this uneasy feeling!? Don't tell me...!
It's that one...!
...Alchemie.
That red one...!
I see, so this is who's been sneaking around behind the scenes.
You again...! This time, we settle it here...!
...Kyosuke...
...My purpose is to oversee... all who... disturb the land of beginnings...
Excellen? Those words again...!? The land of beginnings... Where?
Do you mean Earth...!
The land of beginnings...?
What does that mean? Earth...?
The land of beginnings is Earth? That makes no sense!
My role is... to oversee the universe.
My wish is a silent... universe...
(What... What is making Excellen say this...?)
The land of beginnings... will once again... change the universe...
The land of beginnings that changed the universe... bears power anew...
Enough of your nonsense.
...Kyosuke...
...I don't know what you're getting at.
But your business has nothing to do with Excellen...! I'm taking her back!
Nothing to do...? You should know... Kyosuke...
that's not true at all. Me and... Excellen...
...I said it has nothing to do with her...!
Kyo...suke... I...
I'll... handle... this... so the rest... is up to you...
The magnetic field readings...!?
Excellen! You...
You just keep getting in my way... don't you, Excellen...
All hands on deck! Prepare to sortie!
...Sorry, Excellen. I'll save you, I swear...!
That won't do. ...If only I could have you... I...
Don't worry. I'll come for you... before Excellen.
But I'm bringing a lump of steel with me. ...Don't think you'll get off easy...!
then destroy Rein Weissritter with Alteisen Riese.
1. Ra Cailum or Alteisen Riese destroyed. 2. Win conditions unmet.
All right, the magnetic field's gone! All units, spread out and engage!
...This isn't fun at all...
...That's how the world works.
Though the people of the land of beginnings have no future left...
I'm not about to spout something naive like "we carve our own future."
But my will to fight right now won't bend!
(I don't know what's happening around us... or to us ourselves.
But I'll save you... Excellen.)
You're going down!
Using Excellen to do as you please... It's gonna cost you!
Why...? Me and... Excellen... What's the difference...?
What...!?
I... can't leave this place...
The end of the land of beginnings, a new beginning... There, perhaps...
(This one... Could it be Excellen's...?)
Ugh... But now... everything is in place.
The land of beginnings... a new... seed...
...The land... of beginnings... Earth...
In place? What is...!?
...Kyosuke... then... I...
Ugh... uuh...
Excellen!
Now there's only you left...!
Do you have a plan!?
Kyosuke!
Most likely... the red orb on its forehead... If I can just crush that...
What!? You're gonna snipe that!?
It won't be easy... You understand that!?
...I have to. And I will.
Kyosuke!
We'll back you up all the way...!
Thanks. ...Now all that's left is to pierce it...!
It looks the same... but how is she!?
Excellen!
Can you hear me!? Excellen Browning!
This is Bright Noa!
Did you do it!? Nanbu!
The Weissritter's still the same... but what about Excellen inside!?
The Weissritter's shape!?
It's... back to normal!
Could it be...! Can you hear me!? Excellen Browning!
This is Bright Noa!
Did you do it!? Nanbu!
The Weissritter's back to normal... Is Excellen inside okay too!?
Excellen...! Come back!
Mmm... Kyosuke...?
Excellen!
She's conscious... Is she back to her senses!?
Ugh~, my head is pounding... Huh? Huh-huh?
...Oh, um, Excellen Browning, reporting back!
Excellen! Are you okay!?
You'd better be the real one this time!
Wow, what a welcome. Couldn't you thank your big sis for her trouble?
...Same as ever.
Finally. She sure put us through a lot.
But she wouldn't crack jokes at a time like this... right?
Huh? What's that about? Kyosuke?
Nothing.
All right, now all that's left...!
Right. We wipe out the enemies in this airspace...!
...Kyosuke...
...Thanks... Really. ...I...
...Don't worry about it. Just be your usual self.
...Okay...
Looks like it's over...
I don't see any others.
Their presence has vanished too... Looks like we're safe.
Status of this airspace!?
...No readings of note.
Thank goodness... Looks like we prevented the worst.
Indeed. We still don't know who the enemy really is...
but we'll have to be content with having recovered Excellen Browning.
...Excellen, good work. Are you all right?
...Sorry for all the trouble.
Excellen Browning, returning to the front lines!
Geez, where the heck have you been wandering off to all this time?
Are you... feeling all right? Nothing wrong with you?
Totally fine! My skin's as firm and glowing as ever.
Same old Excellen. What a relief. Right, Kyosuke?
Yeah, I guess.
She hasn't changed a bit either.
Uh, you're the one who's changed way too much.
Quick comeback! But that's what makes her Excellen.
I have plenty of questions. But for now, we head to the next point.
Roger.
Just to be safe, you're getting a thorough checkup too.
Understood.
(It starts here... Something... something big is about to move.)
